title: The Butlers (c) v. Detroit Street Thugs — FoB Tag Championships

date.source: the thread's own posting date on the fed's own board

source: The only FoB roleplay thread the archive holds. The booker's own opening post is the card for the FoB Tag Team Championship match at the Igloo — “The Detroit Street Thugs won a #1 contenders match over Future Perfect at Rebirth. Will they be able to keep their undefeated streak this week when they face the current Tag Team Champions?” One of the two teams wrote: the Detroit Street Thugs, whose ninth promo has the brothers sitting outside the arena talking about a malevolent step-father whose destruction is their ultimate goal, and ends with Mouse dancing and quoting Bachman-Turner Overdrive at the camera.
